notes.title: Update 1.3: COMPLIANCE AND COSMETIC UPDATE
notes.content:
System has deployed Patch v1.3, aimed at improving operative experience metrics and reinforcing long-term retention within breach zones.  

[hr][/hr]                          Notable Adjustments:



Expanded Achievement Protocols — Additional commendations have been authorized for unusual finds, thorough investigation, and Operative  completionists.





Difficulty Modifiers Adjusted — Operatives proved more effective than System predicted. Normal Difficulty site available by default once more and tweaked Breach pacing.





UI Calibration — Improved Interface with Total Reported Breach Tracker added and Variation added to Game over/ Site Secure screens offering Operatives "gentle encouragement..."





Graphic Design Overhaul New, Upgraded key artwork to attract more Operatives to systems cold, calculating embrace.



[hr][/hr]

    All Operatives are advised to remain prepared. The next transmission will contain new Breach coordinates, A high-threat, high difficulty operation is imminent. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644065/67c2047283e44eca1ae9974aa683099ceb75fbdd.png"]Eyes Open— Control

notes.title: FIELD PROTOCOL UPDATE: VERSION 1.2 DEPLOYED
notes.content:
As per revised breach-handling protocols, the Negligence Containment Division has released Patch 1.2, designed to assist Operatives struggling under the escalating hostility within Breach: 83.

Key augmentations include:


Difficulty Response Calibration
 -Operatives may now unlock and select from multiple operational difficulty tiers. Whether you're a first-time initiate or a veteran of the Breach, there is now a setting aligned to your resilience threshold.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644065/54ecacfe2e8531727379b4e6303063f4f1f22fc5.png"]


Enhanced Report Protocol
-Object interaction protocols have received refinement. Operatives may now report Breaches with the aptly named "REPORT" button. Allowing Operatives to use their intuition rather than pinpointing exact Breach locations.


Basic Controller Integration
-Operatives may now operate with Analog input devices. Analog precision will be fine tuned and improved in the next patch
Small QOL adjustments
-Level timer added, Countdown timer when max Breaches limit reached added, Max Breaches increased from 5-7, countdown time when max Breaches reached doubled. 



The Breach adapts... but so do we.

Remember: Observation breeds survival. Adaptation ensures it.

Operatives are advised to recalibrate their loadouts and test new control bindings before re-entering affected zones.

Continue your work. We watch the watchers.

— Control



*Dev addendum. Next Patch will focus on lighting. Current setup is optimised for HDR displays, Non HDR displays as a result appear gratuitously dark. Fixing this is my current priority. Also looking to add more interesting achievements and improve artwork shortly
